instructions: Every external fact on this site traces to one of these entries. The verification column records how the source was reached, not that the site agrees with it.

rows.name: Amazon Associates Program Operating Agreement
rows.supports: The requirement that outbound links use the Special Link tagged formats; the definition of Program Content; the compliance requirements; the site identification requirement.
rows.verified: Opened directly on 2026-11-20. The page states Updated: October 15, 2025.

rows.name: Amazon Associates Program Policies
rows.supports: The Special Link and Associate ID rules; the prohibition on associating a sub-tag or reporting with a specific end user; the requirement that Special Links link to Products and that list pages carry original content; the Commission Income Statement; the IP License and trademark rules.
rows.verified: Opened directly on 2026-11-20. The page states Updated: April 14, 2026.

rows.name: Associates Program Participation Requirements
rows.supports: Rules on Special Links, incentives, pop-ups, and placing Special Links on an Amazon Site.
rows.verified: Linked from the Program Policies page and returned the Participation Requirements text on 2026-11-20.

rows.name: Associates Program help topic: application FAQs
rows.supports: The description of special tagged links and the Associate ID format; the requirement to identify the site as an Amazon Associate using the provided language; the expectation of original content of value to the reader.

rows.name: PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice
rows.supports: The statement that Product Advertising API 5.0 is deprecated, that continuing calls receive HTTP 403 with an AccessDeniedException, and that the Creators API is the supported successor.
rows.verified: Reached on 2026-11-20 from the Product Advertising API 5 documentation URL, which now resolves here.

rows.name: Creators API introduction
rows.supports: The programmatic catalogue access path that replaces PA-API 5 for publishers and affiliate partners.
rows.verified: Linked from the deprecation notice on 2026-11-20.

rows.name: Migrating to Creators API from PA-API
rows.supports: The step-by-step migration path for an existing catalogue integration.
rows.verified: Linked from the deprecation notice on 2026-11-20.

rows.name: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
rows.supports: The clear-and-conspicuous disclosure principle; the rule that an endorsement must be honest and must not be used to make a claim the marketer could not legally make; the affiliate and network marketing section.

rows.name: 16 CFR Part 255, Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
rows.supports: The Endorsement Guides themselves, revised in 2023, including the definition of clearly and conspicuously.
rows.verified: Linked from the FTC Endorsement Guides page on 2026-11-20.

rows.name: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
rows.supports: Practical disclosure placement guidance, including the plain-language and proximity principles.
rows.verified: Linked from the FTC Endorsement Guides page on 2026-11-20.

rows.name: Soliciting and Paying for Online Reviews: A Guide for Marketers
rows.supports: The boundary between incentivised reviews and genuine editorial content, which shapes how the site handles any review-derived material.
rows.verified: Linked from the FTC Endorsement Guides page on 2026-11-20.
